desks.title: American consumers face pitfalls with rise of 'buy now, pay later'
desks.summary: Black Friday is no longer limited to just a single day, yet it remains one of the busiest days of the year for brick-and-mortar stores, where shoppers can still stand in long lines. Now, 90 million of those consumers have turned to “buy now, pay later” financing programs. Economics correspondent Paul Solman looks at how this form of financing is becoming pervasive, and for many, a problem.

desks.title: Flying during flu season? Microbiologist shares 5 precautions worth taking
